title: Card
description: AX-01 assistant fact card, schema v1. One card per number the assistant may quote. Design: _roadmap/_ai-integration/_evidence/ax-audit-2026-11-07/design-ai-access.md section 2.2.
$comment: Stored form: the assistant_cards parquet table, one row per card, one partition per season (season=<yyyy>) plus one _global partition for cards with scope.season null. Scalar columns: id VARCHAR, kind VARCHAR, metric VARCHAR, label VARCHAR, value VARCHAR (JSON-encoded scalar, so numbers, strings and booleans share one column; NULL when the card has no value), unit VARCHAR, display VARCHAR, unavailable_reason VARCHAR, n_count INTEGER, n_unit VARCHAR, interval_low DOUBLE, interval_high DOUBLE, interval_level DOUBLE, interval_kind VARCHAR (NULL when interval is null), sample VARCHAR, grade VARCHAR, status VARCHAR, held_reason VARCHAR, season INTEGER (= scope.season). JSON-string columns: interval_source_columns, scope, source, versions, page, caveats, policy_fields. Generated types: app/scripts/gen-card-types.mjs writes app/src/assistant/cards/card.types.ts and scripts/assistant_cards/card_types.py; a test fails when they are stale. The validator (validate.ts) interprets this file directly, using only the keywords listed in SUPPORTED_KEYWORDS there.

id.description: Deterministic id, kind ':' scope key ':' variant, for example race_lost.component:2024_8:LEC:compound. Must start with the card's kind followed by ':'.

metric.description: Source metric name, for example era_adjusted_rating.

label.description: What kind of number this is. unavailable is a value with a reason, never 0.

value.description: The number. Null only when label is unavailable or status is held.

unit.description: Unit of value, for example s, laps, pct.

display.description: Value pre-formatted at the page's display precision.

n.description: Sample size. Required on every card; 0 for held and unavailable cards.

unit.description: Enum because the THIN_SAMPLE policy trigger matches the literal stints.

interval.description: Uncertainty interval. kind is copied from the registry entry, never inferred. Required (non-null, kind not none) for modelled and experimental cards that are not held.

kind.description: ci_normal_95 is estimate +/- 1.96 x SE (era rating). ci_order_stat_median is the distribution-free CI for a median (race rating after TX-01). wilson_95 is the Wilson score interval for a proportion at 95% (race-control pooled rates, features/race-control/transform.ts#wilson).

mart.description: Published table the value comes from.

transform.description: path#export of the transform the card is built from.

model_version.description: ML model version where it applies (HD8).

registry.description: sha256 of the serialised registry specs (AX-04).

policy_fields.description: Registry-supplied flags that policy.json triggers read; flattened onto the checker card by toCheckerCard.

rating_trust_label.description: TX-01 race-rating trust label (ok, thin, suppressed); not the isolation trust_label.

skill_measure.description: Which of the six skill measures the value is (AX-21 glossary), e.g. teammate_paired_median.

shared_input_group.description: Cards in one group share inputs and are not independent evidence (AX-21).

coverage_reason.description: TX-02 mart_race_coverage.coverage_reason for the card's race.

teammate_id.description: AX-10b: the teammate the value is measured against, from mart_race_driver_summary.teammate_id; null when the mart has none. The card store reads this before any display-text derivation.

allOf.$comment: unavailable: no value, and a reason.
held: published without a value, with a reason.
modelled and experimental cards that carry a value need a real interval.
value is null only when the card is unavailable or held.
